node_5.description: Abdul holds that maintaining harmony within one's close relationships matters more than asserting one's own individual position.

node_6.description: Abdul feels that bringing shame on one's family or group through one's conduct is one of the worst things that can happen, more than private guilt over a personal failing.

node_7.description: Abdul holds a balanced view that both striving for achievement and caring for others' wellbeing are legitimate ways to live a good life, without strongly favoring one over the other.

node_8.description: Abdul believes it's natural to feel pride in accomplishment while also feeling it's important to remain warm and supportive toward those who are struggling.

node_9.description: Abdul believes that being singled out as the best is flattering but slightly uncomfortable, since standing out too far above others can strain a relationship more than it's worth.

node_10.description: Abdul believes practical results matter more than sticking rigidly to fixed procedures, and is comfortable adapting on the fly when situations call for it.

node_11.description: Abdul feels little discomfort with loosely defined plans or schedules, seeing flexibility as normal rather than something to be tolerated.

node_12.description: Abdul believes unfamiliar people, ideas, or ways of doing things are more often interesting than threatening.

node_13.description: Abdul believes there are lasting truths about right and wrong, while accepting that how they apply can depend on the situation.

node_14.description: Abdul feels genuine respect for inherited traditions and sees them as worth preserving largely as they are.

node_15.description: Abdul sees worth both in achieving visible results soon and in working patiently toward later gains, without strongly favouring one over the other.

node_16.description: Abdul believes it's healthy to pursue enjoyment and act on one's desires rather than constantly suppressing them.

node_17.description: Abdul holds a generally optimistic outlook, expecting good things are possible and feeling personally capable of shaping outcomes.

node_18.description: Abdul values having time and freedom to enjoy leisure and spend as one wishes, without feeling this needs to be earned or justified.
